context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Razorpay keys — never authorize a real payment. Preview DB has 0 paid transactions (all 13 are 'initiated' — the paid ones live in production). To E2E validate the emailer + _finalize_paid() flow end-to-end on preview, main agent's direct-call verification (emailer.send('subscription_success') and notify_admin('admin_payment_alert') both returning {sent:True}) is the correct approach. All required data-testids present on Payments tab: admin-tab-payments, admin-payments, payments-search, payments-filter-all, payments-filter-paid, payments-count, payment-row-<id>.
rca of the issue: Original 'no email' bug: buyer email was not carried through to the finalization step, so emailer.send() was skipped. Fix (already deployed on preview by main agent): Razorpay order creation resolves user profile server-side (email/mobile/country/uid/customerId) and stores on TX. A unified idempotent _finalize_paid() is called from both Razorpay /verify + webhook and Stripe _sync_status; it activates the subscription and sends BOTH the user 'subscription_success' and admin 'admin_payment_alert' emails via Resend, and enriches the TX for the CMS. Preview cannot demonstrate end-to-end paid flow (live keys, no test payments), but every code path leading up to _finalize_paid is verified: admin endpoint schema, filter correctness, gateway routing regression, and CMS UI rendering.
